Attribute.Name: Is the record categorized?
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    i:=path(),
    parent:=listitem(
        i,
         listlen(i)-1
    ),
    parentID:=iterate(parent, 'stepid()'),
    isCategorized:=if(parentID="INT.UnCatLevel1", 'false', 'true'),
    grandParent:=listitem(
        i,
         listlen(i)-2
    ),
    grandParentID:=iterate(grandParent, 'stepid()'),
    isParentCategorized:=if(grandParentID="INT.UnCatLevel1", 'false', 'true')
}
if(
    isCategorized='false',
     iterate(
        stepurl2objid(
            stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_RecordUncategorized")
        ),"value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"
    ),
    if(
        isParentCategorized='false',
         iterate(
            stepurl2objid(
                stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductUncategorized")
            ),"value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"
        ),
        iterate(
            stepurl2objid(
                stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_CategorizedInInternalHierarchy")
            ),"value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"
        )
    )
)"/>
